evidence.why: Vendor (OpenAI) API key is compiled into the client binary via dart-define constant and used directly from the mobile app to call OpenAI, rather than being held server-side.
The client directly authenticates to the vendor API (api.openai.com) using the embedded key, confirming the vendor credential is shipped in/used by the client artifact.
Mobile client talks directly to the vendor's API rather than to the developer's own backend that would hold the secret.

controls_present: HTTPS used for the OpenAI endpoint
